properties.displayName: Audit Event ASIM parser for AWS CloudTrail EC2 VerifiedAccess activity
properties.query:
let parser = (disabled: bool = false, pack: bool = false) {
  let Events = datatable(EventName: string, EventType: string, Object: string)
  [
    "AttachVerifiedAccessTrustProvider", "Set", "EC2 Instance",
    "CreateVerifiedAccessEndpoint", "Create", "Verified Access Endpoint",
    "CreateVerifiedAccessGroup", "Create", "Verified Access Group",
    "CreateVerifiedAccessInstance", "Create", "Verified Access Instance",
    "CreateVerifiedAccessTrustProvider", "Create", "Verified Access Trust Provider",
    "DeleteVerifiedAccessEndpoint", "Delete", "Verified Access Endpoint",
    "DeleteVerifiedAccessGroup", "Delete", "Verified Access Group",
    "DeleteVerifiedAccessInstance", "Delete", "Verified Access Instance",
    "DeleteVerifiedAccessTrustProvider", "Delete", "Verified Access Trust Provider",
    "DescribeVerifiedAccessEndpoints", "Read", "Verified Access Endpoint",
    "DescribeVerifiedAccessGroups", "Read", "Verified Access Group",
    "DescribeVerifiedAccessInstanceLoggingConfigurations", "Read", "Verified Access Instance Logging Configuration",
    "DescribeVerifiedAccessInstances", "Read", "Verified Access Instance",
    "DescribeVerifiedAccessTrustProviders", "Read", "Verified Access Trust Provider",
    "DetachVerifiedAccessTrustProvider", "Set", "Verified Access Trust Provider",
    "ExportVerifiedAccessInstanceClientConfiguration", "Execute", "Verfied Access Instance",
    "GetVerifiedAccessEndpointPolicy", "Read", "Verified Access Endpoint",
    "GetVerifiedAccessEndpointTargets", "Read", "Verified Access Endpoint",
    "GetVerifiedAccessGroupPolicy", "Read", "Verified Access Group Policy",
    "ModifyVerifiedAccessEndpoint", "Set", "Verified Access Endpoint",
    "ModifyVerifiedAccessEndpointPolicy", "Set", "Verified Access Endpoint Policy",
    "ModifyVerifiedAccessGroup", "Set", "Verified Access Group",
    "ModifyVerifiedAccessGroupPolicy", "Set", "Verified Access Group Policy",
    "ModifyVerifiedAccessInstance", "Set", "Verified Access Instance",
    "ModifyVerifiedAccessInstanceLoggingConfiguration", "Set", "Verified Access Instance",
    "ModifyVerifiedAccessTrustProvider", "Set", "Verified Access Trust Provider"
  ];
  AWSCloudTrail
  | where not(disabled)
  | where EventSource == "ec2.amazonaws.com"
  | where EventName in (Events | project EventName)
  | lookup kind=inner Events on EventName
  | extend RequestParameters = todynamic(RequestParameters), ResponseElements = todynamic(ResponseElements)
  | extend EventResult = iff(isempty(ErrorCode) and isempty(ErrorMessage), "Success", "Failure")
  | extend NewValue = iff(EventResult == "Success", case(
      EventName in ("AttachVerifiedAccessTrustProvider", "CreateVerifiedAccessInstance",
        "ModifyVerifiedAccessInstance"), ResponseElements.verifiedAccessInstance,
      EventName in ("CreateVerifiedAccessEndpoint", "ModifyVerifiedAccessEndpoint"),
        ResponseElements.verifiedAccessEndpoint,
      EventName in ("CreateVerifiedAccessGroup", "ModifyVerifiedAccessGroup"),
        ResponseElements.verifiedAccessGroup,
      EventName in ("CreateVerifiedAccessTrustProvider", "ModifyVerifiedAccessTrustProvider"),
        ResponseElements.verifiedAccessTrustProvider,
      EventName == "ExportVerifiedAccessInstanceClientConfiguration", ResponseElements.openVpnConfigurationSet,
      EventName in ("ModifyVerifiedAccessEndpointPolicy", "ModifyVerifiedAccessGroupPolicy"),
        ResponseElements.sseSpecification,
      EventName == "ModifyVerifiedAccessInstanceLoggingConfiguration", ResponseElements.loggingConfiguration,
      ""
    ), "")
  | extend ObjectId = case(
      EventName in ("AttachVerifiedAccessTrustProvider", "DeleteVerifiedAccessInstance",
        "DescribeVerifiedAccessInstanceLoggingConfigurations", "DescribeVerifiedAccessInstances",
        "ExportVerifiedAccessInstanceClientConfiguration", "ModifyVerifiedAccessGroup",
        "ModifyVerifiedAccessInstance", "ModifyVerifiedAccessInstanceLoggingConfiguration"),
        RequestParameters.VerifiedAccessInstanceId,
      EventName == "CreateVerifiedAccessEndpoint",
        ResponseElements.verifiedAccessEndpoint.verifiedAccessEndpointId,
      EventName == "CreateVerifiedAccessGroup", ResponseElements.verifiedAccessGroup.verifiedAccessGroupId,
      EventName == "CreateVerifiedAccessInstance",
        ResponseElements.verifiedAccessInstance.verifiedAccessInstanceId,
      EventName == "CreateVerifiedAccessTrustProvider",
        ResponseElements.verifiedAccessTrustProvider.verifiedAccessTrustProviderId,
      EventName in ("DeleteVerifiedAccessEndpoint", "GetVerifiedAccessEndpointPolicy",
        "GetVerifiedAccessEndpointTargets", "ModifyVerifiedAccessEndpointPolicy"),
        RequestParameters.VerifiedAccessEndpointId,
      EventName in ("DeleteVerifiedAccessGroup", "DescribeVerifiedAccessEndpoints",
        "DescribeVerifiedAccessGroups", "GetVerifiedAccessGroupPolicy", "ModifyVerifiedAccessEndpoint",
        "ModifyVerifiedAccessGroupPolicy"), RequestParameters.VerifiedAccessGroupId,
      EventName in ("DeleteVerifiedAccessTrustProvider", "DescribeVerifiedAccessTrustProviders",
        "DetachVerifiedAccessTrustProvider", "ModifyVerifiedAccessTrustProvider"),
        RequestParameters.VerifiedAccessTrustProviderId,
      ""
    )
  | extend
      Type = "AWSCloudTrail",
      EventCount = int(1),
      EventStartTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventEndTime = TimeGenerated,
      EventSeverity = "Informational",
      EventSchema = "AuditEvent",
      EventSchemaVersion = "1.0.0",
      EventVendor = "AWS",
      EventProduct = "CloudTrail",
      Dvc = "CloudTrail",
      EventMessage = ErrorMessage,
      ObjectType = "Cloud Resource",
      TargetAppName = "Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud",
      TargetAppType = "Service"
  | project-rename
      EventOriginalSubType = EventTypeName,
      EventOriginalType = EventName,
      EventUid = AwsEventId,
      EventOriginalResultDetails = ErrorMessage,
      EventProductVersion = EventVersion,
      ActorUserId = UserIdentityAccountId,
      ActorUsername = UserIdentityUserName,
      ActorOriginalUserType = UserIdentityType,
      HttpUserAgent = UserAgent
  | extend
      ActorUserIdType = iff(isempty(ActorUserId), "", "AWSId"),
      ActorUsernameType = iff(isempty(ActorUsername), "", "Simple"),
      SrcIpAddr = iff(ipv4_is_in_range(SourceIpAddress, "0.0.0.0/0"), SourceIpAddress, ""),
      ActingApplicationEntityKey = "",
      ActorUserAdditionalIds = dynamic([]),
      ActorUserEntityKey = "",
      AdditionalEntities = dynamic([]),
      DvcEntityKey = "",
      SrcSystemEntityKey = "",
      TargetApplicationEntityKey = "",
      TargetSystemEntityKey = ""
  | extend AdditionalFields = iff(pack, bag_pack(
      "ActorAccessKeyId", UserIdentityAccessKeyId,
      "AWSRegion", AWSRegion,
      "APIVersion", APIVersion,
      "ManagementEvent", ManagementEvent,
      "ReadOnly", ReadOnly,
      "RequestParameters", RequestParameters,
      "ResponseElements", ResponseElements
    ), dynamic({}))
  | extend
      Operation = EventOriginalType,
      User = ActorUsername,
      IpAddr = SrcIpAddr,
      Application = TargetAppName,
      Value = NewValue
  | project
      TimeGenerated, Type, EventCount, EventStartTime, EventEndTime, EventSeverity,
      EventSchema, EventSchemaVersion, EventVendor, EventProduct, Dvc, EventResult,
      EventMessage, TargetAppName, EventOriginalSubType, EventOriginalType, EventUid,
      EventOriginalResultDetails, EventProductVersion, ActorUserId, ActorUsername,
      ActorOriginalUserType, HttpUserAgent, ActorUserIdType, ActorUsernameType,
      SrcIpAddr, AdditionalFields, User, IpAddr, Application, EventType, NewValue,
      Value, ObjectId, ObjectType, Object, TargetAppType, Operation,
      ActingApplicationEntityKey, ActorUserAdditionalIds, ActorUserEntityKey,
      AdditionalEntities, DvcEntityKey, SrcSystemEntityKey,
      TargetApplicationEntityKey, TargetSystemEntityKey
};
parser(disabled=disabled, pack=pack)
